jobs.title: Full-time, BJU, Inc. , Benefitted Biology Faculty POSITION SUMMARY: Invest in the future by providing young believers with engaging, hands-on, student-centered instruction from a Christian worldview in undergraduate courses (both lecture and lab) in the biology major. A candidate with a Ph.D. in an organismal biology field or related discipline, such as veterinary medicine, horticultural science, or ecology, is desired. The faculty member will join a diverse but unified team of passionate, undergraduate-focused scholars who are committed to excellence in propelling young Christian biologists into careers and graduate studies in biology.

The ideal candidate brings excellence in studio and/or design practice, strong pedagogical skills, and the ability to integrate a biblical worldview naturally into teaching and mentorship. This role engages deeply in a collaborative, team-oriented environment where we prepare students to create with purpose, serve with humility, and pursue their higher calling with skill and conviction.
